text: Write a one-page status memo as a Word document named Atlas_Status.docx in my work folder. Title: Project Atlas Status. Three headings: Summary, Risks, Next Steps. Under Summary, two sentences, and the word Approved in bold. Under Risks, a bulleted list of three risks. Under Next Steps, a table with columns Milestone and Date and three rows: Design freeze 14 November 2026, Pilot 5 December 2026, Launch 20 January 2027. It must open as a normal editable Word document.
